payload.title: One collection layout for Articles, Research, Reading, and Posts
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: apply the Articles layout (newest few large with the image beside the text, then a card grid, then pagination) to Research, Reading, and Posts. One shared collection template driven from a config table in gatsby-node.js; the separate research, reading, blog, and posts-list pages and templates are removed. Old /posts/N/ URLs redirect to /posts/page/N/.
